title: Deploy Prometheus and Query Metrics
description: Install the kube‑prometheus‑stack using Helm and run basic PromQL queries.
problemStatement:
## 🎯 Goal
Get hands‑on with Prometheus by deploying the full stack and querying metrics.

### Prerequisites
- Helm installed.
- Enough cluster resources (at least 2 GB RAM free).

### Steps
1. Add the Prometheus community Helm repo and update:
   ```bash
   helm repo add prometheus-community https://prometheus-community.github.io/helm-charts
   helm repo update
   ```
2. Install the stack in a new `monitoring` namespace:
   ```bash
   helm install monitor prometheus-community/kube-prometheus-stack -n monitoring --create-namespace
   ```
3. Wait for all Pods to be ready: `kubectl get pods -n monitoring -w`.
4. Access Prometheus UI:
   ```bash
   kubectl port-forward svc/monitor-kube-prometheus-prometheus -n monitoring 9090:9090
   ```
   Open `http://localhost:9090` in your browser.
5. In the Prometheus UI, go to the Graph tab and try these queries:
   - `up` – shows which targets are up.
   - `container_memory_usage_bytes{namespace="monitoring"}` – memory usage of monitoring pods.
   - `rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode="idle"}[5m])` – idle CPU rate per node.
6. Check the Service Discovery page (Status → Service Discovery) to see which Kubernetes endpoints Prometheus is scraping.
7. (Optional) Access Grafana:
   ```bash
   kubectl port-forward svc/monitor-grafana -n monitoring 3000:80
   ```
   Login with admin / (get password from Secret).
8. Clean up (optional): `helm uninstall monitor -n monitoring` and delete namespace.
hints: The initial install may take a few minutes to pull images.
If port-forward fails, check the service names: `kubectl get svc -n monitoring`.
Grafana password: `kubectl get secret monitor-grafana -n monitoring -o jsonpath="{.data.admin-password}" | base64 --decode`.
expectedOutput: Prometheus UI accessible, queries return metric data, targets show up as healthy.
solutionCode:
helm repo add prometheus-community https://prometheus-community.github.io/helm-charts
helm install monitor prometheus-community/kube-prometheus-stack -n monitoring --create-namespace
# Wait for pods
kubectl port-forward svc/monitor-kube-prometheus-prometheus -n monitoring 9090:9090
